def r(x):
    # Non-linear monotonic transform: sqrt(x) >= x for x in [0, 1].
    # This pushes inputs towards 1, ensuring the number of successes
    # (and thus posterior mean) increases or stays the same.
    return np.sqrt(x)

def R(y_orig, y_new):
    # The relation expects the output to not decrease (monotonicity).
    # We also check finiteness to filter out numerical errors.
    return np.isfinite(y_orig) and np.isfinite(y_new) and y_new >= y_orig
